cues: Comprehensive, well-organized 12-section structure (goals, architecture, lifecycle, guardrails, rollout, evaluation, observability, stack, milestones, risks) typical of a strong default LLM plan
No explicit methodology artifacts such as stated assumptions, alternatives considered, decision records, or explicit verification/checklist sections
Ends with a 'core principle' summary line and includes open questions, which is common in default outputs too
Concrete details (L0–L4 autonomy ladder, state machine, guardrail table, weeks-based milestones) show thoroughness but not a distinctive prescribed format
Uniform polished formatting with ASCII diagram and table, consistent with unconstrained model style rather than a rigid template
